current_best_claim_scope: Exact executed custom input/split/metric protocol, not best within our small inspected local set
current_reference: VASSI archived run00 plus conventional geometry/ExtraTrees anchor
current_reference_limitations: Seven-offset pose input at 3 Hz centers differs from full-frame models.
Video foundation/pose-pretraining resources and tuning budgets differ.
Four-class macro F1 cannot be replaced by reported mAP, foreground F1 or raw accuracy.
Public data and 19 test videos are not independent animal-population guarantees.
recommended_next_comparator: First reproduce VASSI/Top-1 on identical sampled centers and four-class macro F1 with an input-matched pose-only tier; separately report full-pose/full-video tiers for ResiFuse, FERAL and V-TRACE. Freeze train-only selection and several seeds.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
